crew.overview: Wounded to the brink of death and suffering from amnesia, Jason Bourne is rescued at sea by a fisherman. With nothing to go on but a Swiss bank account number, he starts to reconstruct his life, but finds that many people he encounters want him dead. However, Bourne realizes that he has the combat and mental skills of a world-class spy—but who does he work for?
crew.title: The Bourne Identity

crew.overview: It has been nine years since we last met Jesse and Celine, the French-American couple who once met on a train in Vienna. They now live in Paris with twin daughters but have spent a summer in Greece at the invitation of an author colleague of Jesse's. When the vacation is over and Jesse must send his teenage son off to the States, he begins to question his life decisions, and his relationship with Celine is at risk.
crew.title: Before Midnight

details.biography: Kostas is Head of Production at Faliro House since 2012. He was born in Athens in 1968 and studied physics in Athens and film in Athens and Stockholm. He has more than 25 years of experience as a Line Producer and has been involved in more than 30 productions. His credits include THE WEAPING MEADOW by T. Angelopoulos, BRIDES by P. Voulgaris, ATTENBERG by A. Tsangari, THE LOBSTER by Y. Lanthimos, BEFORE MIDNIGHT by R. Linklater. He was part of the production team of the Opening and Closing Ceremonies of the Athens 2004 Summer Olympic Games. Kostas has also been lecturing Film Production at the School of Film of the Aristotle University of Thessaloniki since 2009.
details.name: Kostas Kefalas
